statement: Let x_i = points[i][0] and y_i = points[i][1]. The function returns a result r, and r is the minimum, over all spanning trees T of the complete graph on vertex set {0,...,n-1}, of sum_{ {i,j} in T } (|x_i - x_j| + |y_i - y_j|). Here a spanning tree is a set of unordered pairs {i,j} with 0 <= i < j < n such that the graph on {0,...,n-1} with edge set T is connected and has exactly n-1 edges; for n=1 the only spanning tree is the empty set with cost 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(points). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, -1000000 <= points[i][0] <= 1000000, and -1000000 <= points[i][1] <= 1000000; and for all 0 <= i < j < n, (points[i][0], points[i][1]) != (points[j][0], points[j][1]).

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access out of bounds.
preconditions: Let n = len(points). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, -1000000 <= points[i][0] <= 1000000, and -1000000 <= points[i][1] <= 1000000; and for all 0 <= i < j < n, (points[i][0], points[i][1]) != (points[j][0], points[j][1]).

statement: Let span_x = max_{0 <= i < n} points[i][0] - min_{0 <= i < n} points[i][0] and span_y = max_{0 <= i < n} points[i][1] - min_{0 <= i < n} points[i][1]. The returned value r satisfies r >= span_x + span_y.
preconditions: Let n = len(points). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, -1000000 <= points[i][0] <= 1000000, and -1000000 <= points[i][1] <= 1000000; and for all 0 <= i < j < n, (points[i][0], points[i][1]) != (points[j][0], points[j][1]).

statement: The returned value r satisfies r <= (len(points) - 1) * 4000000.
preconditions: Let n = len(points). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, -1000000 <= points[i][0] <= 1000000, and -1000000 <= points[i][1] <= 1000000; and for all 0 <= i < j < n, (points[i][0], points[i][1]) != (points[j][0], points[j][1]).

statement: Let d(0,i) = |points[0][0] - points[i][0]| + |points[0][1] - points[i][1]|. The returned value r satisfies r <= sum_{i=1}^{len(points)-1} d(0,i), where the sum is 0 when len(points)=1.

statement: The returned value r satisfies r >= len(points) - 1.

statement: The function returns r = |points[0][0] - points[1][0]| + |points[0][1] - points[1][1]|.

statement: Let max_y = max_{0 <= i < n} points[i][1] and min_y = min_{0 <= i < n} points[i][1]. The function returns r = max_y - min_y.

statement: Let x_i = points[i][0] and y_i = points[i][1]. There exists a spanning tree T of the complete graph on {0,...,n-1} (a set of n-1 unordered index pairs {i,j} that connects all vertices) such that the returned value r equals sum_{ {i,j} in T } (|x_i - x_j| + |y_i - y_j|).

statement: For any bijection π of {0,...,n-1}, let q be the slice of length n with q[i] = points[π(i)] for 0 <= i < n. Then the value returned by min_cost_connect_points(q) equals the value returned by min_cost_connect_points(points).

Then the value returned by min_cost_connect_points(q) equals the value returned by min_cost_connect_points(points).

statement: Let q be the slice of length n with q[i] = [points[i][1], points[i][0]] for 0 <= i < n. Then the value returned by min_cost_connect_points(q) equals the value returned by min_cost_connect_points(points).
preconditions: Let n = len(points). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, -1000000 <= points[i][0] <= 1000000, and -1000000 <= points[i][1] <= 1000000; and for all 0 <= i < j < n, (points[i][0], points[i][1]) != (points[j][0], points[j][1]).

statement: Let D = max_{0 <= i < j < n} (|points[i][0] - points[j][0]| + |points[i][1] - points[j][1]|), with D = 0 when n = 1. The function returns r = D.
preconditions: Let n = len(points). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, -1000000 <= points[i][0] <= 1000000, and -1000000 <= points[i][1] <= 1000000; and for all 0 <= i < j < n, (points[i][0], points[i][1]) != (points[j][0], points[j][1]). Also all points lie on a common straight line, i.e. there exist real numbers a, b, c with (a,b) != (0,0) and a*points[i][0] + b*points[i][1] = c for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Let W be the multiset of all values |points[i][0] - points[j][0]| + |points[i][1] - points[j][1]| for 0 <= i < j < n. Let L be the sum of the n-1 smallest elements of W, with L = 0 when n = 1. The returned value r satisfies r >= L.
